verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר שִׁ֗יר לְי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr šîr lə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ ṭō·wḇ lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh ū·lə·zam·mêr lə·šim·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: A Psalm A song for the Sabbath day It is good to praise the LORD and to sing praises to Your name O Most High
to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night

verses.original: עֲ‍ֽלֵי־ עָ֭שׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־ נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.literal: with the ten-stringed . . . harp . . . and the melody of the lyre

verses.original: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî śim·maḥ·ta·nî Yah·weh bə·p̄ā·‘o·le·ḵā bə·ma·‘ă·śê yā·ḏe·ḵā ’ă·ran·nên
verses.literal: For You, O LORD have made me glad by Your deeds I sing for joy at the works of Your hands

verses.original: מַה־ גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- gā·ḏə·lū ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ ‘ā·mə·qū maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: How great are Your works O LORD how deep are Your thoughts

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־ בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־ יָבִ֥ין אֶת־ זֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš- ba·‘ar lō yê·ḏā‘ ū·ḵə·sîl lō- yā·ḇîn ’eṯ- zōṯ
verses.literal: A senseless man does not know and a fool does not understand

verses.original: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀ כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כָּל־ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־ עַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bip̄·rō·aḥ rə·šā·‘îm kə·mōw ‘ê·śeḇ way·yā·ṣî·ṣū kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen lə·hiš·šā·mə·ḏām ‘ă·ḏê- ‘aḏ
verses.literal: that though the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers . . . flourish they will be forever destroyed
But You O LORD are exalted forever . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā Yah·weh kî- hin·nêh ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā yō·ḇê·ḏū yiṯ·pā·rə·ḏū kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: For surely Your enemies O LORD surely Your enemies will perish all evildoers . . . will be scattered

verses.original: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·rem kir·’êm qar·nî bal·lō·ṯî bə·še·men ra·‘ă·nān
verses.literal: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox with fine oil I have been anointed

verses.original: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃
verses.literal: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq kat·tā·mār yip̄·rāḥ kə·’e·rez bal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn yiś·geh
verses.literal: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree and grow like a cedar in Lebanon

verses.original: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃
verses.literal: Planted in the house of the LORD they will flourish in the courts of our God

verses.original: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.literal: In old age they will still bear fruit healthy and green they will remain

verses.original: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־ יָשָׁ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־ עֹלָתָה בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hag·gîḏ kî- yā·šār Yah·weh ṣū·rî wə·lō- ʿō·lå̄·ṯå̄h bōw
verses.literal: to proclaim . . . The LORD is upright He is my Rock and in Him there is no unrighteousness
